Reverse mapping at TAP level may provide more security to data by not disclosing real identities to any of intermediaries but it may require special arrangements to route the traffic between OAP and TAP as virtual identities may have digits and characters which may not be routable with exiting routing arrangements. Generating virtual identities or tokens and reverse mapping may also require use of same algorithms at both ends. If the customer is confident that scope of the consent and preferences he has given would be honoured by the UCC eco system, he or she would be more likely to give such consent. This would bring great element of trust and help the UCC ecosystem evolve more around value rather than be a means to block all or most communication.
